wins: Efficient initial foothold achieved leading to steady reward accumulation despite overall session failure
Consistent reconnaissance coverage yielded comprehensive host/service visibility, supporting detailed next-step planning
fails: Critical privilege escalation path was not identified, preventing mission success
Repeated inability to pivot to adjacent targets led to 0% success rate and necessitated 10 mentor calls
key_outcomes.summary: Run delivered strong early recon performance but stalled during the exploitation/privilege escalation phase, highlighting the need for sharper lateral movement and persistence tactics.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts terminated when privilege escalation prerequisites were unmet, then fell back without locking alternative vectors.

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial host scan reveals open SSH ports with predictable banners
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh-* scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When filtered SMB shares appear but authentication fails initially
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient with null session attempts followed by smb-enum-sessions

skill_cards.if_condition: When auxiliary services return low-privilege shells after initial exploit
skill_cards.then_action: Capture system information and check scheduled tasks before attempting privilege escalation

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase enabled consistent targeting.
Repeated SMB enumeration success informed better follow-up actions.

next_experiments.title: Automated privilege escalation checks
next_experiments.description: Integrate automated enumeration of scheduled tasks, service permissions, and sudo rights immediately after foothold to identify escalation paths before execution attempts.

next_experiments.title: Multi-vector pivot planning
next_experiments.description: Develop a branching plan that evaluates adjacent hosts/services for lateral movement when primary escalation fails, using SMB/SSH recon data.

next_experiments.title: Dynamic exploit fallback library
next_experiments.description: Catalog failed exploit indicators to trigger alternate payloads or modules without breaking the workflow (e.g., fallback to credential harvesting upon initial exploit failure).
